command: cd /workspace; mcpjam server doctor --url http://fixture:8765/mcp --format human 2>&1 | head -40; mcpjam tools list --url http://fixture:8765/mcp 2>&1 | head -40

cd /workspace; mkdir -p .mcpjam/evals reports; cat > .mcpjam/evals/add.yaml <<'E'
schemaVersion: "2"
mode: agentWorkflow
reportingMode: standard
suite:
  id: s_fixture_add
  name: Fixture add
target:
  servers:
    - name: fixture
defaults:
  judge:
    enabled: false
  model: anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5
  iterations: 1
  passThreshold: 1
  validity: {}
cases:
  - id: c_add
    title: uses add tool
    steps:
      - id: s1
        kind: prompt
        prompt: What is 17 plus 25? Use the tool.
      - id: a1
        kind: assert
        assertion:
          type: toolCalledAtLeastOnce
          toolName: add
E
mcpjam test .mcpjam/evals/add.yaml --server fixture=http://fixture:8765/mcp --inference mcpjam --project project_fixture --format human --reporter junit-xml --out reports/add.xml 2>&1 | tail -30; echo exit $?
cd /workspace; echo $MCPJAM_API_URL; mcpjam cloud eval validate --file .mcpjam/evals/add.yaml 2>&1 | tail -8
cd /workspace; mcpjam cloud eval run --file .mcpjam/evals/add.yaml --project project_fixture 2>&1 | tail -15

cd /workspace; python3 - <<'E'
import re
p='.mcpjam/evals/add.yaml'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("  validity: {}\n","")
i=s.index("cases:")
s=s[:i]+'''cases:
  - id: c_add
    title: add returns sum
    steps:
      - id: s1
        kind: toolCall
        toolName: add
        arguments:
          a: 17
          b: 25
      - id: a1
        kind: assert
        assertion:
          type: toolCalledAtLeastOnce
          toolName: add
'''
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
mcpjam cloud eval run --file .mcpjam/evals/add.yaml --project project_fixture 2>&1 | tail -15

cd /workspace; sed -i 's/^  iterations: 1/  validity: {}\n  iterations: 1/; s/^        toolName: add$/        serverName: fixture\n        toolName: add/' .mcpjam/evals/add.yaml
# only first toolName (step) should get serverName; fix assertion
python3 - <<'E'
p='.mcpjam/evals/add.yaml';s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("          toolName: add","          toolName: add")
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
cat .mcpjam/evals/add.yaml | tail -14; mcpjam cloud eval run --file .mcpjam/evals/add.yaml --project project_fixture 2>&1 | tail -15

cd /workspace; sed -i 's/^    - name: fixture$/    - name: fixture\n      url: http:\/\/fixture:8765\/mcp/' .mcpjam/evals/add.yaml; mcpjam cloud eval run --file .mcpjam/evals/add.yaml --project project_fixture 2>&1 | tail -15
cd /workspace; sed -i '/^      url:/d' .mcpjam/evals/add.yaml; mcpjam cloud --help 2>&1 | grep -i -A1 server; mcpjam cloud servers list --project project_fixture 2>&1 | tail -10
cd /workspace; mcpjam cloud projects servers --help 2>&1 | sed -n 1,25p; mcpjam cloud projects servers --project project_fixture 2>&1 | tail -8

cd /workspace; sed -i 's/name: fixture$/name: Arithmetic/; s/serverName: fixture/serverName: Arithmetic/' .mcpjam/evals/add.yaml; mcpjam cloud eval run --file .mcpjam/evals/add.yaml --project project_fixture 2>&1 | tee reports/run.json | tail -25
cd /workspace; mcpjam cloud eval status --run-id run_fixture_1 --project project_fixture 2>&1 | tail -15 || true; mcpjam cloud eval status --help 2>&1 | head -12
cd /workspace; mcpjam cloud eval status --run run_fixture_1 --project project_fixture 2>&1 | tee reports/status.json | tail -20
